evidence.claim: 카믈로 뒤 루아는 1908~1936년 활동한 악시옹 프랑세즈의 극우 청년 조직이다.
evidence.excerpt: The King's Camelots, officially the National Federation of the King's Camelots (French: Fédération nationale des Camelots du Roi) was a far-right youth organization of the French militant royalist and integralist movement Action Française active from 1908 to 1936.

evidence.claim: 프랑시슴(프랑시스트당·프랑시스트 운동, 1933~1944)은 뷔카르가 이끈 파시스트 정당이었다.
evidence.excerpt: Le Francisme, ou Parti franciste ou Mouvement franciste (1933-1944), était un parti politique fasciste dirigé par Marcel Bucard.

newAffiliations.note: Id per coordinator (french-francisme). Kind left as force to match the id prefix, but fr:Parti franciste calls it a party and it was one in 1941–1944 — a term is still wanted. Banned as a league in 1936, failed relaunch in 1938, refounded as the Parti franciste in 1941 (en: Mouvement Franciste). The periods leave out 1936–1941; use [[1933, 1944]] if a continuous span is preferred.

evidence.claim: 페소는 조르주 발루아가 세운, 파시즘을 공공연히 내건 최초의 프랑스 정당이었다.
evidence.excerpt: La même année, il adhère, parmi les premiers, au Faisceau de Georges Valois — premier parti à se revendiquer ouvertement du fascisme — et dont il est chargé de la direction de la propagande à partir de septembre 1926.

newAffiliations.note: Founded November 1925 by Georges Valois, dissolved 1928 (dates from the general record; check fr:Le Faisceau before registering). The existing François Coty card calls it 「파소」; the 표기법 form of [fɛso] is 페소 — pick one and align both.

evidence.locator: fr: Militant catholique et parlementaire anti-maçon et antisémite
evidence.excerpt: Il est également membre du comité de direction du Parti républicain national et social (PRNS) de Pierre Taittinger à partir de 1937.

newAffiliations.note: Taittinger’s party successor to the Jeunesses Patriotes after the 1936 dissolution; periods are approximate — verify against fr:Jeunesses patriotes / Pierre Taittinger before registering. Could alternatively be dropped and Vallat’s PRNS row removed.

evidence.locator: fr: Militant catholique et parlementaire anti-maçon et antisémite
evidence.excerpt: il milite pour la Fédération nationale catholique et intègre l'année suivante son comité exécutif.

newAffiliations.note: Founded 1924 by General de Castelnau (general record; verify the end date before registering).

catalogNotes: french-solidarite-francaise is catalogued 1933–1936, but fr:Solidarité française dates the organisation 1933–1939: after the June 1936 dissolution it continued as the Parti du rassemblement français and, from June 1937, the Parti du faisceau français. Consider extending its periods to [[1933, 1939]] rather than adding a new id; Renaud’s activity is kept at 1933–1936 because no source states his leadership of the successor party explicitly.

collectionNotes.maurice-pujo: monarchist fits (royalist leader), but Maurras and Daudet are only in counterrevolution; drop monarchist to keep the Action Française cards uniform, or add it to all three.
collectionNotes.xavier-vallat: conservative is defensible for his Republican Federation vice-presidency; left out because Taittinger (same party) is only in counterrevolution.
collectionNotes.jean-renaud: fascist on the strength of the 1934–1937 blue-shirt turn and his self-description as fascist (sf-fr); the league itself is contested between fascist and classic league in the literature.
